log.note: baseline: two coaches, three seasons; identical on 9cb4058 (pre-split) and the split. Coach A's result line is blank every season (known bug)

Grading fix 2: in a hot seat every coach but the last got a blank result line and a grade computed from it, because writeSeasonHistory called SEA.resultLine, which never existed. It now uses seasonResult. Coach A: '' C+/C/C+ -> first round B, ReliaQuest Bowl C+, quarterfinals B. Coach B unchanged.
History entry v2: the book's format changes, its content doesn't; records, results and grades for both coaches identical to the previous recording.
Hot-seat coaches' entries written at hand-over are now completed with the league tables when the season ends; records, results and grades unchanged

People are fired on their grades: two missed seasons in a row at the same job (grade line 'Short of the mark' or worse), never one; the carousel no longer judges or poaches human coaches, and can't fill a fired user's job before they're told. History entries record miss. Carousel random draws for human-coached teams are gone, so careers diverge from their first offseason; Rice#2024 (college) is now fired after its second straight miss instead of after a B season.
One coaching carousel per offseason in a hot seat (it ran once per coach, roughly doubling coaching changes: 34 against 17 in the first college year); coach records counted once
